reasons.text: The duplicate check found another claim (9a853e1f-6423-5b58-a6c8-c031fd1a6963) sharing the same address. Under the claim policy, any shared address sends the claim to a person for review together with the matched claim.

All other checks pass: the label photo is legible and shows model MK04, which is recalled; the serial starts with BN; the date code (June 2025) is before July 2025; Amazon.com is a listed retailer and the purchase date falls inside the sale window. These do not override the duplicate flag.
No destruction photo is required for this remedy (replacement), so that check does not affect the outcome.
